purpose: Teach: 智子/秀夫/美香/花園/小人/夫君/姐/追い出し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの智子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you talking to Tomoko from the next class over.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Casual opening. Slight uptick at the end like she's fishing for a reaction without pushing too hard.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父様、秀夫さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your dad's name is Hideo, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question of his own. Quiet, level tone. Not defensive but redirecting. Slight pause before the name, like he's buying time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの美香と仲良いな
lines.en: Riku — you're pretty close with Mika from the next class, aren't you?
lines.style: Pressing gently. Warm but observant. Slight emphasis on 'close.' She's testing whether he'll admit or dodge again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で京都御所の花園習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You studied the Kyoto Imperial Palace gardens in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting again with another counter-question. Same quiet, measured pace. He's turned this into a back-and-forth and he knows it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、白雪姫の七人の小人の名前覚えてたな
lines.en: Riku — you actually remembered all seven dwarf names from Snow White.
lines.style: Dry, slightly exasperated affection. Playful jab at something trivial he said or did. Quick pace, knowing tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語で「ご主人」つまり夫君って単語覚えたな、桜
lines.en: You learned that English word for 'husband' — 'lord and master' — remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry counter-jab. Slight edge of humor. He's matching her energy now, turning something small she mentioned into ammunition.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画で「姐さん」のキャラ好きだったろ
lines.en: Riku — didn't you like that 'older sister' character in that manga?
lines.style: Circling back to safer ground. Lighter, less pointed. She's still testing but with more affection showing through the curiosity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業生の追い出しコンパに行ったろ、桜
lines.en: You went to that senior farewell party, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final deflection, softer this time. Close and quiet, like they're sharing a small secret. Tired but warm — the defensiveness dropping just slightly.
